text:
Ana Patel: Heads-up: Northshore confirmed a small Nova Scotia pilot. Scope: colocated edge, Dedicated nodes (3x A100-equivalent), customer-managed KMS, and a marketplace tile. Target soft-launch: 2025-02-10. Need owners for quota request, security checklist, and PR blurb.

Leah Kim: I can take marketplace + assets. Please send logo, a short 2-sentence partner blurb, and a contact for co-marketing approvals. ETA for draft listing: 3 business days after assets arrive.

Northshore (Carlos): Well provide the logo (SVG + PNG), partner blurb, and an initial cost/usage estimate. Baseline: 8k req/day, bursts to 30k/day. Were planning 3 reserved nodes (A100-eq) with a burst pool for peak traffic.

Omar Aziz: Infra note: we need SKU IDs and the cloud region (AWS ca-central-1 or GCP ca-central). Also prefer to know seq length and avg tokens/request for correct node sizing. If AWS, quota lead time ~5-8 business days.

Northshore (Carlos): AWS ca-central-1. Average payload ~150 tokens/request, peaks at ~600 tokens. SKU suggestion from their ops: a100e-48g-std (x3) plus burst pool +2.

Leah Kim: Asset specs we need: logo SVG (transparent), 1200x628 PNG, short logo alt text, and a 300-word partner blurb. Drop to https://go/redwood/partners/northshore/assets or DM me.

Omar Aziz: Filing quota request now. Creating cloud ticket: CREQ-NS-2345. Request: 3 reserved a100e-48g nodes + 2 burst nodes, start date 2025-01-15, duration 6 months. Link: https://console.cloud.example/CREQ-NS-2345

infra-bot: Provision plan created: `pilot-ns-edge-v1`  status: awaiting quota approval.

Ana Patel: Security/KMS question: will Northshore hold the CMK in their AWS account and cross-account grant Redwood, or will Redwood bring its own key? We need the flow documented for compliance.

Northshore (Carlos): We prefer Northshore-managed CMK with cross-account grants to Redwood service account. Rotation policy: quarterly. We have SOC2 Type II report we can share.

Omar Aziz: Cross-account grants are workable. Raj (security) will need the grant IAM policy, key ARN, and rotation settings. Also require VPC peering + flow logs enabled.

Ana Patel: Legal/PR: we want a short co-announcement but keep it \"pilot\" language. Can legal review a one-paragraph announcement and a list of approved security claims by EOD next Friday?

legal-ops: Yes. Send the draft PR + a bulleted list of security claim statements (e.g., \"customer-managed keys\", \"SLA for dedicated nodes\") and we'll run it through the approval flow. Allow 3 business days for review.

Leah Kim: Draft marketplace copy (working): \"Northshore + Redwood: Pilot Nova Scotia edge for low-latency LLM serving. Dedicated GPU capacity with customer-managed keys and enterprise peering.\" Thoughts?

Northshore (Carlos): Good start. Add: \"Available to select partners during pilot; enterprise onboarding supported.\"

Ana Patel: Risks: if quota approval is delayed beyond 2025-01-15 we lose launch window. Backup: run pilot on Hosted with smaller instances (2x rtx6000-eq) and feature-flag the marketplace listing until quotas are live. Who owns backup?

Omar Aziz: Ill own the fallback provisioning. If CREQ stalls, Ill spin up a temporary Hosted cluster and update routing. Will need product sign-off for feature flags.

Leah Kim: Marketing will prep a \"pilot waitlist\" landing page that points to Hosted availability as fallback. Need one engineering bullet and hero asset by 2025-01-08.

Northshore (Carlos): We'll upload assets by 2024-12-22 and send a legal contact for the DPA addendum.

infra-bot: CREQ-NS-2345 status: submitted. Estimated approval: 6 business days (monitoring).

Ana Patel: Action list recap: 1) Omar: cloud quota ticket CREQ-NS-2345 (link posted) 2) Raj/security: provide KMS acceptance checklist and IAM grant template 3) Leah: marketplace draft once assets arrive 4) Legal: PR approval flow + DPA addendum draft. Internal review cutoff: 2025-01-25. Next sync Tues 15:00 UTC.

Omar Aziz: Added comment to CREQ-NS-2345 with SKU IDs and workload profile.

Northshore (Carlos): Confirmed asset upload target 2024-12-22.

Ana Patel: Thanks everyone  keep this thread updated with ticket links and approvals.
